rich2021Activities: Original IM2021 G5 U08:L14 is a STUDENT-DESIGNED Notice and Wonder instructional routine. It cannot be made source-faithful by substituting a predetermined number quiz for collecting classmates' perceptions, presenting images and recording questions.

Warm-up Notice and Wonder Sharing Bread uses a source credited photograph by Couleur/Pixabay to prompt fraction interpretation of how a quantity is shared. Actual source image pixels and license terms are not silently reconstructed from text.

Activity1 Design Your Notice and Wonder: learner FINDS an image about sharing or interpreting a fraction as a quotient and writes POSSIBLE notices and wonders; participants select their own authentic image and justify why it will elicit mathematical thought.

Activity2 Facilitate Your Notice and Wonder: learner displays chosen image, poses both Notice/Wonder prompts, gives peer quiet think/discussion time, has classmates share and RECORDS their real observations. Teacher checks original delivery, accuracy and respectful facilitation.

Activity3 Design Your Notice and Wonder Part2: choose a NEW image about ANY mathematics learned during the year and predict what students notice/wonder. Gated original photo, learner artifact, peer interaction and end reflection require teacher review; selected digital cases check only original PROCEDURAL rules.
